QuestInfo.name: Black Wings' New Weapon
QuestInfo.0: Talk to #p2151002#, who seems to have recovered.
QuestInfo.1:
The Black Wings's new weapon has already been completed. #p2151002# realized how dangerous it was and tried to destroy it, but ended up getting thrown in jail. You can't just sit there and do nothing! Destroy the #rBlack Wings's new weapon#k and rescue #p2151002#!

#o9001035##r #a230501##k

#b* If you leave the map, you can enter again through the hidden laboratory entrance in #r#m310060220##b.
QuestInfo.2: After completely destroying the Black Wings' new weapon, you returned with #p2151002# using the Underground Base #t4032740#. It was no easy task, but your execution was perfect.

0.0: (Belle stares fiercely around the room.) \r\nGood, now I can finally talk. Where to begin... When I first started this mission, I was just going to stop them from building their new weapon, but when I got here, it was already done. It was a #r#o9001035##k...
0.1: So I had to move on to plan B: rip the weapon to pieces. But I got a little carried away and couldn't endure the poison. In the end, it knocked me out and I woke up in a cage...
0.2: With your #t4032740#, it'd be easy to escape this place, but I want my vengeance on that weapon! Plus, a device of that magnitude could wipe out all of Edelstein in an instant. No, we cannot let it exist.

yes.0: (Belle snarls.) \r\nTo be honest, you probably won't be able to endure the poison, but that shouldn't stop you from trying. Didn't stop me... But I have faith in you. No other student has ever progressed as quickly as you. If anyone can do this, it is you.
yes.1: The new weapon isn't far. You see that #bdoor#k? That old coot, #p2154009#, was goading me, placing my cage right next to the weapon. But we are short on time! Quickly! Destroy it before he can whet the appetite of his new weapon on Edelstein!

no.0: If those miserable Black Wings use the poison gas to attack our town, the entire town will be wiped out! Think it over! You're as good as condemning your neighbors to death!

mob.0: The #r#o9001035##k still stands! Quick, destroy it. I knew I should've brought more antidotes and potions.
